npcs.name: Sulik
npcs.motivation: Find his kidnapped sister and repay his debt to Maida Buckner.

npcs.name: Vic the Trader
npcs.motivation: Escape Metzger's slaver lockup and assist the Chosen One with repair expertise.

npcs.name: John Cassidy
npcs.motivation: Leave his failing bar in the Vault City courtyard and see the wasteland one last time.

npcs.name: Myron
npcs.motivation: Enjoy luxury, chems, and safety under armed protection.

npcs.name: Sheriff Marcus
npcs.motivation: Maintain peace between humans, ghouls, and super mutants in Broken Hills.

npcs.name: Goris
npcs.motivation: Study human philosophy and protect the intelligent pack from eradication.

npcs.name: First Citizen Lynette
npcs.motivation: Preserve genetic and cultural purity of Vault City; subjugate wasteland out-dwellers.

npcs.name: Harold the Ghoul
npcs.motivation: Procure a hydroelectric replacement part from Vault City so the reactor doesn't melt down.

npcs.name: President Tandi
npcs.role: President of the New California Republic
npcs.motivation: Federate California's northern frontier under the rule of law and secure Vault 15 parts.

npcs.name: John Bishop
npcs.motivation: Conspire with NCR and hire raiders to force Vault City into annexation.

npcs.name: President Dick Richardson
npcs.motivation: Release modified FEV Curling-13 toxins into the global jet stream to purge impure mutant humanity.

npcs.name: Secret Service Agent Frank Horrigan
npcs.motivation: Annihilate all enemies of the United States government and execute the Chosen One.

npcs.name: Metzger
npcs.motivation: Extract maximum caps from human trafficking across the northern wastes.

npcs.name: The Village Elder
npcs.motivation: Save her starving people by dispatching the Chosen One to find the holy G.E.C.K.

npcs.name: Gruthar
npcs.motivation: Protect his sentient pack from human fear and secure the Voice Recognition module.

items.description: Terraforming marvel containing cold fusion generators and recombinant seed banks.

items.name: Advanced Power Armor Mk II
items.description: Enclave matte-black composite powered exoskeleton granting immense physical and radiation shielding.

items.name: Bozar .223 Machine Gun
items.description: Devastating sniper-support heavy machine gun firing high-velocity 15-round bursts.

items.name: Turbo Plasma Rifle
items.description: Supercharged plasma cannon firing accelerated superheated matter bolts.

items.name: Chryslus Motors Highwayman
items.description: Fusion-powered pre-war sedan allowing rapid, fatigue-free wasteland overmap traversal.

items.name: Pip-Boy 2000 Personal Terminal
items.description: Arm-mounted RobCo terminal with local maps, Geiger counter, and quest log.

items.name: Vertibird Technical Flight Blueprints
items.description: Classified schematics required by the Shi and Brotherhood of Steel.

items.name: Presidential Key FOB Access Card
items.description: Biometric electronic keycard required to trigger emergency containment scuttling.

activeTopology.description: The complete Fallout 2 campaign ported to Creator Studio. Features a 17-node Northern California wasteland overmap and 17 scale-fluid submaps covering Arroyo, Den, Modoc, Vault City, Gecko, Broken Hills, New Reno, Sierra Army Depot, NCR, Vaults 13 & 15, Military Base, San Francisco, Navarro, and the Enclave Oil Rig.
